descriptor: Turn your AI chats into links you’ll be proud to share.

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
worth sharing.
directions.mantra: Give good work a good form.
directions.rationale: The retained Folio identity: considered paper, Instrument Sans, sculptural book imagery, and a warm ribbon accent on the page-turn mark.
directions.alt: A fan of ivory book pages with a muted vermilion ribbon.
directions.markRationale: The retained Folio page-turn geometry, used in the warm accent color.

directions.name: Passage
headline: Good conversations.
Beautifully shared.
directions.descriptor: Turn a public AI chat into a thoughtful preview, with the highlights up front and the full conversation behind it.
directions.announcement: A little more context. A much better link.
directions.rationale: The current Passage homepage, captured as an identity: a quiet white interface, clear Inter typography, an overlapping-page mark, and a painted landscape that gives the shared work room.
directions.alt: A soft impressionistic lake landscape with water lilies, trees, and distant misty hills.
directions.markRationale: The existing two outlined pages, unchanged from the homepage BrandMark component.

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
worth sharing.
directions.mantra: Give good work a good form.
directions.rationale: Folio’s words in Passage’s centered, open composition. Inter, a white and charcoal palette, the outlined-page mark, and the painted landscape carry the visual identity.
directions.alt: A soft impressionistic lake landscape with water lilies, trees, and distant misty hills.
directions.markRationale: Passage’s existing overlapping-page geometry in Charcoal, paired with the Folio name.

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
worth sharing.
directions.mantra: Give good work a good form.
directions.rationale: Folio’s words and page-turn mark meet Passage’s neutral Inter system. A left-aligned introduction and a larger white share create a more direct, asymmetric composition.
directions.alt: A soft impressionistic lake landscape with water lilies, trees, and distant misty hills.
directions.markRationale: Folio’s retained page-turn geometry in Passage’s Charcoal, paired with an Inter wordmark.
